evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of persistent fatigue in the setting of a strong family
history of premature heart disease.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 52 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 167 ms, QRS 90 ms, QTc 450
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findngs: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 270 mg/dL (H)
LDL Cholesterol: 182 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 49 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 195 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 134 mmol/L (L)
Potassium: 3.5 mmol/L
Chloride: 99 mmol/L
CO2: 22 mmol/L
BUN: 21 mg/dL (H)
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Glucose: 110 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 8.7 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth oncce daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily

EXM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral eddema.

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhytm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
